about: Who publishes an industry post, by the post URL's host. One flat organization per company: sub-brands, labs and blogs map to the parent company's name. A host also matches its subdomains (microsoft.com covers azure.microsoft.com). Hosts are written without www. local-dev/import_post_links.py turns each entry into an organization record (reusing one with the same name or website domain) and links every matching post to it as publisher; backend/services/publishers.py falls back to this file for posts without that link. `note` marks a judgement call for review. Hosts left out on purpose: reverser.space and appsecsanta.com (individual authors' sites, not organizations).

organizations.name: Alibaba
organizations.note: Qwen team blog on GitHub Pages; Qwen is Alibaba Cloud's model family. Only the exact qwenlm.github.io host maps, never github.io.

organizations.name: Amazon
organizations.note: aws.amazon.com (AWS Security Blog) and amazon.science both map to Amazon under the flat rule; the curated block still says AWS (curated_company).

organizations.name: GitHub
organizations.note: Kept as its own organization although GitHub is a Microsoft subsidiary (acquired company that operates under its own brand, like Wiz). Change to Microsoft if the parent rule should apply.

organizations.name: Google
organizations.note: DeepMind, Project Zero and Google Cloud blogs map to Google.

organizations.name: Hugging Face
organizations.note: huggingface.co/blog also hosts community posts by non-employees; all map to Hugging Face.

organizations.name: MiniMax
organizations.note: Chinese AI company; international brand name used (Chinese name 稀宇科技).

organizations.name: NSFOCUS
organizations.note: Chinese vendor (绿盟科技); English trade name, all caps as the company writes it.

organizations.name: QiAnXin
organizations.note: Chinese vendor (奇安信), XLab blog. Spelling varies (Qi An Xin, QAX); the company's English site writes QiAnXin.

organizations.name: Qihoo 360
organizations.note: Chinese vendor (奇虎360); blog.netlab.360.com is 360 Netlab. Could also be written 360 Digital Security Group.

organizations.name: Shellphish
organizations.note: Academic CTF team (UCSB/ASU), not a company; existing organization record reused.

organizations.name: Tencent
organizations.note: Chinese company (腾讯); xlab.tencent.com is Xuanwu Lab, hunyuan.tencent.com is the Hunyuan model team. The curated block still says Tencent Xuanwu Lab (curated_company).

organizations.name: ThreatBook
organizations.note: Chinese vendor (微步在线); English trade name.

organizations.name: Trend Micro
organizations.note: Zero Day Initiative is Trend Micro's program, mapped to the parent like Talos -> Cisco.

organizations.name: watchTowr
organizations.note: Lower-case w as the company writes it.

organizations.name: Wiz
organizations.note: Google agreed to acquire Wiz (announced March 2025); kept as its own organization because it publishes under its own brand. Change to Google if acquisitions should fold in.
